blocks.text:
On arrival at the airport, your driver takes you to your hotel. On the way you can already see green hills, favelas, Copacabana beach and everyday life in Rio.

After checking in, the rest of the day is free. You can walk a few blocks to the beach and rent a sun umbrella and deck chairs. For children, quieter spots close to the shore are a good choice.

This first day gives you time to get used to the heat, the ocean and the time difference without a long programme for the children.

You get a feel for Rio from the very first hours: street sounds give way to the ocean, green slopes appear between the buildings, and beach life runs alongside the city's daily routine. High-rise buildings, mountains, forest and sea all share the same panorama.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, a half-day excursion to Sugar Loaf begins.

First you arrive at Praia Vermelha, or Red Beach. From here the cable car climbs first to Urca and then to the summit of Sugar Loaf.

From the top, all of Rio opens up before you: Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado, Copacabana, Ipanema, the Two Brothers mountain, Botafogo, the financial district and Guanabara Bay. Small monkeys often appear on the green slopes.

For children, the journey up is an adventure in itself. The cabin travels above the wooded hillside, the city gradually unfolds below, and from the upper viewing area there is plenty of time to study the bays, beaches and mountains surrounding Rio.
